description: On the tabletop in front of the hands are a small orange, a red plate, a marker, a paintbrush, a die, a small toy saw, and a clear roll of tape. The left hand stays mostly still near the left edge, while the right hand moves in from the right to grasp the clear tape roll as a right-hand object, lifts it, carries it leftward over the other items, and sets it down onto the center of the red plate before letting go.
